preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have an even number of dominoes n, where n is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in dominoes)
preconditions.description: Each domino must contain two integers a_i and b_i that are between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any((a_i, b_i) in set1 and (a_i, b_i) in set2 for a_i, b_i in dominoes) == False
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', no number can appear in both sets of dominoes.
If the output is 'YES', both sets must contain exactly n/2 dominoes.
